notFormalized.instead: **Formalized** (2026-11-13, Part III wave 2; V16.14): `PolyfoldStructure.metrizableSpace` (`P3H_TangentPolyfold.lean`), from Theorem 7.3.1's `theorem_7_3_1_metrizable`. The metrization step is Part I's `metrizableSpace_of_locally` (Chapter 2), so no Smirnov theorem from Mathlib is needed. In 2017 this was the numbered Proposition 16.1; in the 2021 text it is a remark in prose.

notFormalized.title: Stokes on polyfolds without partitions of unity
notFormalized.label: §16.4, Theorem 16.4.6, p. 732 (2017: Theorem 16.5)
notFormalized.book: $\int_{\hat\theta} d\tau = \int_{\partial\hat\theta}\tau$ with no hypothesis on $(Z,c)$ beyond being a polyfold (the standing assumption of Chapter 16 is ZHOU; partitions of unity are not assumed).
notFormalized.instead: `theorem_16_4_6_hyp` and `theorem_16_4_6_eff_hyp` (V16.28), with `c.AdmitsScPartitionsOfUnity` as Theorem 9.5.17 assumes. Removing it needs Stokes on ep-groupoids without partitions of unity, using the compactness of $\mathrm{supp}\,\Theta$ for a finite cut-off. Estimate 300–600 lines.

notFormalized.title: Tameness of branched suborbifolds is invariant
notFormalized.label: §16.4, p. 729, and Definition 16.4.2 (5), p. 730 (2017: Definition 16.30)
notFormalized.book: If $\Theta$ is tame, so are $f_*\Theta$ and $f^*\Theta$.
notFormalized.instead: `IsTame` means some representative is tame (V16.23). The integrals are defined on tame representatives, and independence is proved among those (`integral_eq_of_rel`, V16.27). Transporting `TameBranchingStructure` (Definition 9.3.6) and `OrientedTameStructure` along equivalences of ep-groupoids is not formalized. Estimate 250–500 lines.

notFormalized.title: Naturality of the structure on $\mathrm{supp}\,\theta$
notFormalized.label: §16.4, Proposition 16.4.3, p. 730 (2017: Proposition 16.6)
notFormalized.book: The manifold (orbifold) structure on $\mathrm{supp}\,\theta$ is induced from the overhead and does not depend on the representative.
notFormalized.instead: For every representative: $\mathrm{supp}\,\theta \simeq_t |\mathrm{supp}\,\Theta|$ and Proposition 9.1.9 (`proposition_16_4_3_manifold`, `proposition_16_4_3_orbifold`, V16.24). That two representatives give diffeomorphic structures is not formalized. Estimate 150–300 lines.

notFormalized.title: The tangent projection and the raised polyfolds

notFormalized.book: $(Z,c)^i = (Z_i, c_i)$, and $\tau_Z : T(Z,c) \to Z^1$ with $\tau_Z \circ T\alpha = \alpha \circ |\tau_X|$.
notFormalized.instead: $T(Z,c)$, $T\alpha$, (16.5), Lemma 16.2.2 and Definition 16.2.3 are formalized (`P3H_TangentPolyfold.lean`, V16.16–V16.18). The raised structures $c_i$ (via `liftOne`) and $\tau_Z$ are not. Estimate 100–200 lines.

notFormalized.title: The tangent functor and the pull-back of forms on the polyfold category
notFormalized.label: §16.2, Theorem 16.2.4, p. 719; Theorem 16.2.6 (second part), p. 721 (2017: Theorems 16.1, 16.2)
